description: Country prices for one of the app's products, read from App Store Connect / Google Play (Pro): per country the local price, its USD value and index (US = 100), whether it is still Apple's (or Google's) automatic price, the median of rivals that localize their prices (multiplier against Apple's automatic price, with how many rivals) and the difference in percent, plus a suggested price rounded to an attractive price point with its reason (rival median or income band). Rivals are the app's manual iOS rivals; a country needs at least 3 of them to be compared. summary counts countries priced above and below rivals and still on the automatic price. state is not_connected, pending (the first read is not done yet), permission (the key's role can't read prices), no_products or ok. products lists the other products; pass product to switch.

country.description: two-letter country code to return one row

product.description: product id or SKU (defaults to the first product)

name: get_country_prices
